record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four Oricorio styles in appliesTo declare REVELATION_DANCE (all 3 stars, maxPP 100, range 2, passive NECTAR in the catalog). The strategy is shared; the style is chosen by the caster's name (pokemon.name). The NECTAR passive only appears in the item-transformation effects read (nectar items); it has no part in the cast.
record.summary: Area ability around the caster: every occupied cell in the 3x3 neighbourhood (centre excluded) is processed. Occupants of the caster's team receive a buff chosen by the caster's name (Baile speed, Pa'u special defense, Pom-Pom attack, Sensu shield; apBoost 1, crit passed); occupants of the other team take SPECIAL damage (15/30/50/80 raw by caster stars). The caster is not in its own area, so it never buffs itself.

targeting.who: all occupants of the adjacent cells of the caster; the cast target is passed to the strategy but not used
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true, so the caster must have a target at range to cast, yet the effect ignores that target and uses the caster's position.

geometry.shape: caster-centred 3x3 ring (8 cells), clipped to the board; centre excluded

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); crit multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit, which requires EffectEnum.ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false
effects.resolution: requested amount = raw x AP factor [x crit], applied per occupant; each target's SPE_DEF division (ceil, min 1) and later untraced modifiers decide the applied amount; takenDamage (not used here) would count HP removed plus shield damage; protect / skydiving / magicBounce occupants take none

effects.kind: buff (allies in the ring), style by caster name
effects.scaling: all four pass apBoost 1 and the cast's crit: requested = raw x (1 + AP/100) x (crit ? critPower : 1) for atk, speDef and shield; for speed the same factors are applied after the item helpers (see resolution)
effects.resolution: applied change differs per helper. addAttack / addSpecialDefense: value = round(raw x AP x crit), then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, buff on the holder), Twist Band (no effect on positive team buffs), then atk floored at 1 / speDef floored at 0 (permanent false). addShield: Big Eater Belt first on the raw value, then PokemonState.addShield scales by AP and crit, halves it if the target is enraged, rounds, and adds it to the shield (separate from HP). addSpeed: Big Eater Belt and Twist Band adjust the raw value first, then AP and crit scale it (not rounded), added and clamped to 0..300; a MELMETAL-passive target gets half the value as attack instead. Not applied to the caster (centre cell excluded), to empty cells or to occupants of the other team; whether dead occupants are filtered was not traced.

buffs.note: permanent flag false: applies to the in-fight entity only

shields.requested: 15/30/50/80 raw by stars x AP x crit
shields.applied: after Big Eater Belt on the raw value, enraged halving, rounding

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; all four are 3-star in the catalog, so the bare values are damage 50 and the style buff 10 speed / 6 speDef / 6 atk / 50 shield. The 4-star values (also the fallbacks) are not reachable by their bare star count.

record.positionalConditions: Adjacency only: the eight cells around the caster, clipped to the board edge. Occupants are classified by team (same team as the caster = ally buff, any other occupant = damage). The caster must have a target at range to cast, but that target need not be adjacent.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast re-applies buffs (stacking, since speed/atk/speDef/shield are added again) and damage. The style is fixed by the caster's name; any other name would buff nobody but would still damage enemies (not reachable for the four listed units).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw per 3-star caster: damage 50, buff 10 speed / 6 speDef / 6 atk / 50 shield. Requested amounts scale with AP and crit; applied amounts additionally go through the stat helper of the style (Big Eater Belt, clamps, rounding, enraged halving for shields) for allies, or SPE_DEF reduction and later modifiers for enemies.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after the later handleDamage modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, the minimum of 1 and the takenDamage accounting were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution beyond the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier
Whether dead or untargettable occupants can still stand in a cell (the ring uses cell.value without a hp or targettability check)
unresolved: Whether any item or synergy effect changes REVELATION_DANCE beyond what is listed (only the Big Eater Belt and Twist Band stat helpers were read)
Whether the speed/ATK conversion for a MELMETAL-passive ally can matter in practice
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
